bagPolicy.summary: Depending on the organiser’s security rules, security may hold backpacks and bags larger than DIN A4 at the entrance; larger luggage cannot be checked at the venue.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Märzparkgarage and Stadthallengarage together provide over 1,400 parking spaces; weekday street parking restrictions apply from 9 a.m. to 10 p.m.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general rideshare pickup location for concerts; consult the event instructions.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The venue has a catering partner, Gourmet Event, and a café open around box office and event hours.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
